candidates: When adding `<script>` or `<link>` tags that load resources from an external CDN (e.g., in `src/docs/index.html` or any other HTML file in the project), always include a Subresource Integrity (SRI) `integrity` attribute containing the cryptographic hash of the resource, along with a matching `crossorigin` attribute. Loading CDN assets without an integrity check exposes users to supply-chain attacks if the CDN or the hosted file is compromised.
